remote-lane-no-claude-attribution.run: git fetch -q origin staging && test "$(git log --since='1 day ago' origin/staging -i --grep='Co-Authored-By: Claude' --grep='Generated with \[Claude Code\]' --format=%H | wc -l)" -eq 0

R2-remote-hotspot-config.run: test "$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments?since=$(date -u -d '1 day ago' +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)&per_page=100" --paginate --jq '[.[]|select(.body|startswith("<!-- FORGE:TRAJECTORY -->"))|select(.body|contains("hotspot_config_missing:"))]|length' | awk '{s+=$1} END{print s+0}')" -eq 0

release-live-run.run: test "$(gh pr list --state all --head staging --limit 20 --json comments --jq '[.[].comments[]|select(.body|contains("FORGE:GATE_"))]|length')" -ge 1

schedd-upgrade-handover.run: test "$(npx --no-install forgedock schedd status 2>&1 | grep -c 'is not hosted')" -eq 0

ceiling-default-set.run: git fetch -q origin staging && test "$(git log origin/staging --grep='ceiling default (#5346)' --format=%H | wc -l)" -ge 1
